# Remove Curse (`spells:remove-curse`)
**Level 3 [Abjuration](../magic-schools/abjuration.md)** | **Casting Time:** Action | **Range:** Touch
**Components:** V, S | **Duration:** Instantaneous | **Classes:** [Cleric](../classes/cleric.md), [Paladin](../classes/paladin.md), [Warlock](../classes/warlock.md), [Wizard](../classes/wizard.md)

At your touch, all curses affecting one creature or object end. If the object is a cursed magic item, its curse remains, but the spell breaks its owner's Attunement to the object so it can be removed or discarded.
